intro: A melting pot of Portuguese, African and Indigenous cooking, famous for its churrasco barbecue, black bean stews and snacks.
flavours: Black beans, cassava (manioc), coconut, palm oil, lime, cachaça
hk: Brazilian churrascarias in Hong Kong serve all-you-can-eat skewers carved at the table.

dishes.name: Feijoada
dishes.what: Black bean stew with assorted pork and sausage, served with rice, farofa, kale and orange.

dishes.name: Picanha
dishes.what: The prized cap of the rump with its fat layer, grilled on skewers at a churrascaria.

dishes.name: Pão de queijo
dishes.what: Chewy, cheesy little bread rolls made with cassava flour; naturally gluten-free.

dishes.name: Moqueca
dishes.what: Bahian fish stew in coconut milk and red palm oil.

dishes.name: Coxinha
dishes.what: Teardrop-shaped fried croquettes of shredded chicken and cream cheese.

dishes.name: Brigadeiro
dishes.what: Fudgy chocolate truffles rolled in sprinkles, a must at every birthday.

dishes.name: Açaí bowl
dishes.what: Frozen açaí berry purée topped with granola and banana.
